title: Frontend Developer
descriptionText:
Role Overview

We are looking for a Frontend Developer with strong hands-on experience in building scalable, high-performance, and user-centric web applications. In this role, you will contribute to our core product platform, developing robust React-based applications used by government agencies and enterprise clients.

You will work closely with product managers, designers, backend engineers, and DevOps teams to deliver high-quality software with real-world impact. This role requires a strong problem-solving mindset, practical engineering experience, and the ability to deliver production-grade applications at scale.

What You Will Do

Develop and maintain scalable React applications for web platforms.
Own end-to-end feature development from implementation to testing and production readiness.
Build and maintain reusable components and shared UI libraries.
Integrate REST APIs, real-time services, and external systems to deliver dynamic user experiences.
Optimize applications for performance, responsiveness, and efficiency.
Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following best practices.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering standards across the team.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless feature delivery.
Identify and resolve performance issues and production defects.
Work within Agile/Scrum environments and contribute to sprint planning and estimations.
Ensure compliance with security and accessibility standards for enterprise/government platforms.
Stay updated with modern React ecosystem trends and frontend best practices.

What You Will Need

5-10 years of frontend development experience, with strong expertise in React.js.
Proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3/SCSS.
Strong understanding of:
React fundamentals (hooks, functional components, lifecycle)
State management (Redux, Zustand, Context API, etc.)
Component-driven architecture
Experience integrating and consuming RESTful APIs in production applications.
Solid experience with performance optimization techniques.
Familiarity with testing frameworks (Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, etc.).
Experience with Git workflows, code reviews, and collaboration tools.
Ability to work effectively in a remote-first, fast-paced environment.

What You Will Bring

Strong problem-solving mindset with practical, real-world experience
Ability to translate requirements into efficient implementations
Good understanding of application performance and security principles
Strong communication and collaboration skills
Proactiveness and ownership in delivering high-quality outcomes
Willingness to learn and stay updated with modern frontend technologies

Good to Have

Experience with modular frontend systems
Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
Familiarity with data visualization libraries (D3.js, Chart.js, etc.)
Knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1)
Working knowledge of Node.js or backend systems for API understanding
Prior experience in GovTech, FinTech, HealthTech, or enterprise domains
Exposure to developing or working with AI/ML applications and platforms
Familiarity with AI-driven technologies, including integrating or operationalizing intelligent systems
Experience working with PDF viewers and related functionalities such as rendering, annotations, document navigation, and performance optimization
Experience in platform engineering is a strong plus

Location : Permanent Remote

This role requires a strong problem-solving mindset, practical engineering experience, and the ability to deliver production-grade applications at scale.

What You Will Do

  • Develop and maintain scalable React applications for web platforms.
  • Own end-to-end feature development from implementation to testing and production readiness.
  • Build and maintain reusable components and shared UI libraries.
  • Integrate REST APIs, real-time services, and external systems to deliver dynamic user experiences.
  • Optimize applications for performance, responsiveness, and efficiency.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following best practices.
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering standards across the team.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless feature delivery.
  • Identify and resolve performance issues and production defects.
  • Work within Agile/Scrum environments and contribute to sprint planning and estimations.
  • Ensure compliance with security and accessibility standards for enterprise/government platforms.
  • Stay updated with modern React ecosystem trends and frontend best practices.

What You Will Need

  • 5-10 years of frontend development experience, with strong expertise in React.js.
  • Proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3/SCSS.
  • Strong understanding of:
    • React fundamentals (hooks, functional components, lifecycle)
    • State management (Redux, Zustand, Context API, etc.)
    • Component-driven architecture
  • Experience integrating and consuming RESTful APIs in production applications.
  • Solid experience with performance optimization techniques.
  • Familiarity with testing frameworks (Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, etc.).
  • Experience with Git workflows, code reviews, and collaboration tools.
  • Ability to work effectively in a remote-first, fast-paced environment.

What You Will Bring

  • Strong problem-solving mindset with practical, real-world experience
  • Ability to translate requirements into efficient implementations
  • Good understanding of application performance and security principles
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Proactiveness and ownership in delivering high-quality outcomes
  • Willingness to learn and stay updated with modern frontend technologies

Good to Have

  • Experience with modular frontend systems
  • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Familiarity with data visualization libraries (D3.js, Chart.js, etc.)
  • Knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1)
  • Working knowledge of Node.js or backend systems for API understanding
  • Prior experience in GovTech, FinTech, HealthTech, or enterprise domains
  • Exposure to developing or working with AI/ML applications and platforms
  • Familiarity with AI-driven technologies, including integrating or operationalizing intelligent systems
  • Experience working with PDF viewers and related functionalities such as rendering, annotations, document navigation, and performance optimization
  • Experience in platform engineering is a strong plus

Location : Permanent Remote

title: Full-Stack Developer (Node.js + React + Go)
descriptionText:
About the Role


We are hiring a Full-Stack Developer to own features end to end: Postgres schema, backend API, React/Next.js UI, deployment and production support.

Our stack is Node.js and Go on the backend, React with TypeScript on the frontend, PostgreSQL (multi-tenant), real-time events over WebSockets and message brokers like kafka, WhatsApp Business API for messaging and calling, and Docker on AWS EC2 behind nginx, deployed through GitHub Actions. We practise test-driven development and use AI coding tools daily to ship faster. You do not need all of this on day one, but you must be strong in Node, React, TypeScript and Postgres, and willing to learn the rest quickly.

Key Responsibilities

Build responsive, accessible UI in React and TypeScript for the customer app, planner portal and admin dashboard.
Create reusable components and hooks; keep the component library consistent with the designer's wireframes.
Consume REST APIs and WebSocket streams; handle loading, error and reconnect states properly.
Keep bundle size and render performance in check; profile and fix slow screens.
Design and build REST and WebSocket APIs in Node.js (TypeScript).
Write Go services for high-throughput or latency-sensitive paths (event fan-out, call handling, background workers).
Design multi-tenant PostgreSQL schemas: tenant isolation, indexing, migrations, query performance.
Implement authentication and authorization (JWT, OAuth, role-based access) across tenants.
Add structured logging, error handling, input validation and rate limiting on every endpoint you ship.
Build event-driven flows using pub/sub and a message broker (Redis Streams, Kafka, RabbitMQ or SQS) so updates reach many tenants reliably.
Integrate the WhatsApp Business (Cloud) API for template and session messaging, webhooks, and voice calling.
Integrate payment gateways, email providers and other third-party services.
Design for failure: retries, idempotency, dead-letter handling, backpressure.
Containerise services with Docker; deploy to AWS EC2 behind nginx (reverse proxy, TLS, load balancing).
Maintain CI/CD on GitHub Actions: tests, builds, deployments; keep the pipeline green.
Write tests first where it matters (unit, integration, API) and treat failing CI as a blocker.
Set up basic monitoring and alerting for what you ship; own production issues through to the fix.
Required Skills and Qualifications

All of the following are required. We will test them in the interview.
1-2 years building and shipping web applications that real users depend on.
Strong TypeScript on both backend (Node.js) and frontend (React with hooks and context).
PostgreSQL beyond CRUD: schema design, indexes, migrations, reading query plans.
RESTful API design, HTTP semantics, JSON, authentication (JWT or OAuth).
HTML5, CSS3 and responsive layout.
Git with branching and pull-request workflows; Docker for local and deployed services.
Has deployed and maintained an application on a Linux server or AWS, not only localhost.
Writes automated tests and can explain what to test and why.
Uses AI coding assistants daily and reviews their output critically.
Can debug an unfamiliar codebase independently and explain findings clearly in writing.
Nice to Have

Go in production, or a strong interest in learning it.
Multi-tenant SaaS: tenant isolation, row-level security, per-tenant performance.
Real-time systems: WebSockets, pub/sub, Redis Streams, Kafka, RabbitMQ or SQS.
WhatsApp Business API, or other messaging and telephony integrations.
nginx configuration, TLS, reverse proxying, basic server hardening.
GitHub Actions pipelines beyond the basics (caching, matrix builds, environment deploys).
Testing tools such as Jest, Vitest, Playwright or Go's testing package.
Experience at an early-stage startup or on a small team that shipped fast.

Soft Skills

Ownership: you see a feature through from idea to production and stay with it when it breaks.
Works independently with little supervision; asks for help early when blocked.
Clear written communication: PR descriptions, short design notes, honest status updates.
Learn new tools fast and is comfortable being the one who figures something out first.
Team-first: reviews others' code carefully and takes review feedback well.

Education


Graduate

descriptionText:
Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled .NET Core + React Developer with 35 years of experience in developing scalable, secure, and high-performance web applications.




Key Responsibilities

Develop and maintain web applications using ASP.NET Core, C#, and React.js.
Design, develop, and integrate RESTful APIs.
Build responsive and reusable React components.
Work with SQL Server, Entity Framework Core, and LINQ.
Implement authentication, authorization, and application security.
Troubleshoot issues, optimize performance, and maintain code quality.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams in an Agile environment.



Required Skills

Strong experience in C#, ASP.NET Core, Web API, and React.js.
Proficiency in JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
Experience with React Hooks, Redux or Context API.
Strong knowledge of SQL Server, Entity Framework Core, and LINQ.
Knowledge of REST API integration, JWT authentication, and Git.
Understanding of OOP, SOLID principles, and design patterns.



Good to Have

Microsoft Azure and Azure DevOps
Docker, Microservices, and CI/CD
Unit Testing (xUnit, NUnit, Jest)
Agile/Scrum methodologies



Qualifications

BE/B.Tech/MCA or equivalent qualification.
35 years of relevant full-stack development experience.
Strong problem-solving and communication skills.



Mandatory Tech Stack: .NET Core | C# | React.js | Web API | SQL Server | JavaScript/TypeScript
